t: You're on North End Road in Fulham, an ancient thoroughfare. It links the former hamlet of North End, now called West Kensington, with the former village of Walham Green, now Fulham Broadway. The explorer Annie Royle Taylor died here. She was an English Evangelical missionary to Tibet and the first Western woman known to have visited the country. In 1892 and 1893 she attempted to reach the forbidden city of Lhasa.
